id.description: Id of the setting, such as default-site

name.description: Name of the setting as the web interface shows it

description.example: What to show when Nginx is hit with an unknown Host

value.description: The chosen value. Its type depends on the setting; the default site holds a string (congratulations, 404, 444, redirect or html)

meta.description: Extra values of the setting as an object. The default site uses redirect, html and status
